status: Source audit only. Current heavy replay has no native-model controller coverage, so this bridge is not a proposed FPS patch for that replay.

census.source: Root reported fresh cold actual census; exact capture/report hash is owned by the root and particle census agent.

ownership: emitter.native_owner is the particle simulation owner and does not prove that model_pose_storage already evaluated its channels.
model.native_owner is the full native Gob/Part controller owner. Ordinary AnimationPlayer actor models use a separate controller path.
model_rigs._update uses one branch or the other, with continue after native_owner.advance; the actor animation clock is not doubled there.
nativeBasis: Scene animation advances eligible Gob AnimRuns, calls AnimateHierarchy, stores controller outputs in Part fields, and calculates emitter admission radius before renderer admission.
Native AnimateParticles reads retained Part fields and does not sample controller channels again.
The complete exact original flow and body hashes are retained in ../render-chain-review.json and ../fresh-a/original-render-chain.snapshot.json.

currentSource.finding: Owner.control updates retained 0x240-byte Part state; kind3 emitter values are available through allocating operation6. Owner.publish currently publishes TRS/material/light state but no direct retained emitter-parameter bridge.
emitter_properties maps a rig node to its private Part and reads operation6, producing a Dictionary. Reusing this accessor per emitter/frame would introduce allocations and engine boundary traffic.
Each active AnimRun applies its clip/weight through pose.apply; final Part values can include multiple blended runs and manual-Part control gates.
_native_clock exposes runsE0[0] as model.clip/time; playback_state returns that single clip/time/serial.
Owner.sample independently evaluates the selected single clip into parameters/state/compact emitter fields, then current pose/bounds admission precedes simulation.

futureBridgePrerequisites: Admit only a validated model.native_owner/native_context cohort and bind immutable Part index/source identity, retaining the context lifetime across callbacks and deferred close.
Read final retained parameter fields after all relevant clip blends and manual-Part gates; do not share merely a first-clip time cache.
Use a typed fixed emitter parameter block and change mask/version rather than per-frame Dictionary snapshots. Avoid copying all fields every frame when selected channels are empty or constant.
Keep standalone/static AnimationPlayer emitters and unsupported controller/hierarchy/reference states on their current path.

Treat detonate and other consumed latches separately. Copying a stale Part latch into a particle owner every frame can retrigger an effect; establish matching controller publication and consumption semantics first.
Preserve synchronous consumer, event, RNG, collision and child-model callback order; do not defer callbacks into a second global phase.
Test multi-run blends, clock changes, manual Part60, context close/reentry and diagnostics against original native behavior before accepting a parity change.
nextMeasuredOpportunity: The current 670 chunk emitters have admission disabled because child bounds are unknown. Case-insensitive NULL chunk resources have provably null child models and can use analytic radius admission without inventing geometry bounds; resource-name census is pending.
